scope: World models only. Navigation backbones remain separately locked in Backbone_Trials.json. DINOv2 with new dynamics and CDiT with new dynamics are two separate baselines.

trials.name: DINO-WM transfer

shared_plan.data_collection: Actual candidate first-action branches and frozen-policy continuations from training scenes. Pilot splits training scenes into model fitting, scorer fitting, and development groups, with shared R2R/RxR scene IDs grouped together. Official unseen evaluation remains separate.
shared_plan.policy_status: Navigation policy is trained first and held frozen during the world-model comparison.
shared_plan.action_interface: Use commanded actions and available timing/history; future realized poses or collision outcomes cannot be conditioning inputs at inference.
shared_plan.proposed_common_scorer_representation: Frozen DINOv2-S/14: source resize/crop224, mean/std0.5, encoder input196px, raw196x384 pooled49x384. DINO pair is frozen. NWM/CDiT CPU asset/bridge checks passed; selected CE weights and GPU execution remain pending.
shared_plan.nwm_interface: CDiT-S/2 candidate, 224 image pixels, 28x28 four-channel VAE latent, four real context frames, nominal normalized x/y/yaw command and relative time. Eight-channel denoiser output requires matching epsilon/learned-variance sampling before four-channel latent decoding.
shared_plan.warmup: Base policy until required real context exists; no silent context padding. Use the same warm-up restriction across compared world models.
scorer_inputs: Actual policy context and current view
shared_plan.scorer_comparison: Fit one scorer per frozen policy using pooled predictions from available frozen world models. Hold exact scorer weights fixed across those world models; no world-model identity input.
shared_plan.stop_prediction: Identity current view; no world-model call
shared_plan.comparison_order: Screen four world models using a fixed trained policy and common CE branch dataset; expand selected configurations across navigation backbones afterward.
shared_plan.initialization_controls: Match architecture, visual representation, trainable parameter set, data, and training budget within each transfer/fresh pair. Otherwise label results as comparisons of training recipes.
